name: FamiliesTips
description: Clan Primer Traveler's Tips: four ungated 'Weapon Families' tips carrying the per-family identity text (moved off weapon help; that runtime feature is reverted separately). Extends the deployed 17-entry state: the 16 native tips plus the Proficiency tip. Titles go into penelosdiary rows 654-657 (IDs 0x16E0-0x16E3), found empty and unreferenced the same way row 661 was. Flag 255 writes check byte 2 = 0xFF, the format's own no-flag-test convention, so the game shows these tips unconditionally.

tips.title: Weapon Families: Heavy
tips.body:
Every weapon family fights its own way, always on.
Greatsword Sweep: Attack cleaves a half circle around
the target for half damage, but the swing is slow.
Axe Sunder: every hit dents the foe's Defence by five
percent, down to half, for the rest of the fight.
Hammer Concussion: Disable 15 percent of the time, and
the knockback pushes the foe out of melee.
Spear Pierce: every hit ignores 30 percent of the
foe's Defence, and a spear never parries.
Fists Cadence: consecutive hits on one foe hit harder,
up to 30 percent more, and charge the next action
faster. Switching targets restarts the ramp.

tips.title: Weapon Families: Light
tips.body:
Every weapon family fights its own way, always on.
Sword Guard: the best weapon evade, but a parry or
block pushes your own next charge back 10 percent.
Katana Chain: combos run two hits longer, yet after a
combo the next attack on you cannot be evaded.
Ninja sword Unseen: hits cannot be parried or blocked.
The target's dodge still applies, plus 10 percent Blind.
Dagger Swift: the fastest charge and frequent combos,
with a little evade on the blade.

tips.title: Weapon Families: Ranged
tips.body:
Every weapon family fights its own way, always on.
Bow Volley: the highest critical rate and the longest
reach on the field.
Crossbow Afflict: on-hit status chances doubled, up to
100 percent.
Gun Marksman: shots ignore Defence and the target's
dodge, but the damage scales with the gun alone.
Hand-bomb Barrage: Slow or Oil 20 percent of the time.

tips.title: Weapon Families: Magick
tips.body:
Every weapon family fights its own way, always on.
Rod Mend: healing spells heal 20 percent more while
held. Potions are unchanged.
Staff Channel: element potency, and the most Magick of
the caster weapons.
Mace Spellbreak: hits burn MP equal to 10 percent of
the damage, at most 10 percent of the foe's pool.
Measure Tempo: hitting an ally grants Protect, Shell,
Bravery, Haste, Invisible or Bubble.
Pole Counterflow: counters even without the Counter
licence, blows taken build the next counter, and the
pole strikes Magick Resist.
